items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk Reveals Details For SpaceX-Tesla Orbiting Data Center
items.summary_cn: Musk 透露 SpaceX 与 Tesla 联合打造在轨数据中心的细节，涉及 AI 与航天交叉领域。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk Shows Detailed Design of AI Data Center Satellite
items.summary_cn: Musk 展示 AI 数据中心卫星的详细设计，推动太空 AI 基础设施概念。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Short-sellers to tread carefully as Musk's SpaceX debuts
items.summary_cn: 报道称 SpaceX 登陆资本市场，做空者需谨慎，暗示航天板块可能迎来新变量。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Commentary: Here's how Musk's SpaceX IPO could crash your 401(k)
items.summary_cn: 评论称 SpaceX IPO 可能冲击 401(k) 退休账户，暗示大规模 IPO 对市场资金的虹吸效应。

items.author: Musk
items.text: SpaceX's stock market blast-off could be Musk's biggest gamble yet
items.summary_cn: 报道称 SpaceX 上市可能是 Musk 最大的赌注，暗示航天板块即将迎来重大事件。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Is Elon Musk’s SpaceX Really Worth $1.75 Trillion?
items.summary_cn: 讨论 SpaceX 是否真的值 1.75 万亿美元估值，引发市场对航天板块估值体系的关注。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Both sides, Israel and Iran, are looking to do an immediate CEASEFIRE! Final negotiations on “Peace” are proceeding, subject to ignorance or stupidity getting in its way. The Blockade will remain in place, and in full force and effect, until a “Final Deal” is reached. Things should move quickly. Thank you for your attention to this matter! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: Trump 称以色列和伊朗正寻求立即停火，封锁将持续至最终协议达成，暗示地缘紧张可能缓和。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Opinion | Elon Musk took out his chainsaw. Government took out its checkbook.
items.summary_cn: 报道称 Musk 拿出电锯削减政府开支，而政府则拿出支票簿应对，暗示政府效率改革与财政支出的冲突。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk bullet-proofed his $1 trillion ‘Mars-shot’ pay at SpaceX after the pay brawl at Tesla
items.summary_cn: 报道称 Musk 在 Tesla 薪酬风波后，为 SpaceX 万亿美元薪酬方案加装防护，涉及公司治理议题。
